data.spec: Implementing food→Oda: official https://oda.com/mcp via OAuth PKCE (scope mcp), read-only product_search/get_cart; manipulate_cart application-only after exact reviewed food basket snapshot. No checkout/payment MCP capability. Existing task/request gets optional grocery:{proposal:OdaFoodProposal|null,cart_url:string|null,state:'connection_required'|'needs_clarification'|'awaiting_approval'|'cart_ready'|'failed'|'uncertain',question?:string,connect_url?:string}; OdaFoodProposal={kind:'oda_cart',supplier:'Oda',lines:[{product_id:int,name,quantity:int,unit_price_nok:number,line_total_nok:number,query:string,url?:string}],subtotal_nok,currency:'NOK',expires_at,checkout_required:true,delivery_fees_pending:true}. Existing proposal remains null for real Oda cart operations; never mark cart_ready as ordered. New status checkout_ready. Source:'oda-food'; grocery agent chooses only actual returned available product IDs, asks clarification on missing food/quantity constraints. New GET /api/integrations/oda, GET /connect (OAuth redirect), GET /callback; native /api/input and /tasks/:id/decide consume grocery. Exact food proposal fingerprint required before cart write, fresh price/availability recheck, persisted started/confirmed/uncertain guard and no blind retry. Frontend new isolated OdaFoodOrder card + bounded mount, preserve Jørg-owned UI/twin.
